label: Phone & Messaging
description: Calling, answering, leaving messages, and texting to stay in touch.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: answering the phone. The greeting алло opens almost every call, and кто это говорит asks who is speaking. Use говорит when you cannot recognize the voice on the line.
Strategic focus: a bad connection. The impersonal слышно describes how audible the other person is, and плохо marks the poor signal. Извините softens the complaint about the call quality.
Strategic focus: promising to call back. The perfective перезвоню means I will call again, and через час sets the time. Use this to end a call politely when you are busy now.

Strategic focus: checking if someone is free to talk. The verb говорить with по телефону asks about phone availability, and сейчас pins it to this moment. A common opener before discussing anything serious.

Strategic focus: leaving a message. The imperative передай asks a third person to relay information, and что я звонил reports that the call happened. The past звонил shows the attempt was already made.
Strategic focus: texting instead of calling. The perfective напишу means I will write, and сообщение is the message itself. Adding позже promises contact later when there is more time.

Strategic focus: taking a call for a busy person. The adjective занят reports that he is occupied, and the polite imperative перезвоните asks the caller to try again. Use позже to suggest a better time.
Strategic focus: switching from call to text. The noun связь names the connection, and плохая marks it as weak. The suggestion давай напишем proposes messaging when the voice line fails.
Strategic focus: keeping someone on the line. The noun трубка means the handset, and не клади трубку tells the other person not to hang up. Подожди asks them to wait a moment.
Strategic focus: asking for a call back. The imperative позвони requests a call, and когда будешь свободен sets the condition of being free. A relaxed way to leave timing up to the other person.
